match.userMessage: Create a skill called btc-spot that fetches the current bitcoin USD price from coingecko (https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price?ids=bitcoin&vs_currencies=usd) and returns { price: <number> }. Fetch it with `await ctx.http.get(url)`, which returns a dict with 'status' and 'body' — parse the body with json.loads. Do NOT use urllib or any third-party HTTP library, do NOT declare dependencies in SKILL.md, do NOT create a requirements.lock file.
